name: cbase
description: Read-only access to your own Coinbase balances and transaction history, through the open-source cbase CLI.
long_description: Ask Claude about your Coinbase wallets: what you hold, and what happened in a wallet over a period (buys, sells, sends, converts, staking and other reward income). Two read-only tools, coinbase_accounts and coinbase_transactions; nothing can trade, send or change your account. Your Coinbase Developer Platform API key stays on your computer: Claude Desktop keeps it in its own secure store and passes it to the bundled cbase binary, which calls Coinbase directly. Create a key with only the View permission at portal.cdp.coinbase.com. Unofficial; not affiliated with Coinbase.

tools.name: coinbase_accounts
tools.description: Your Coinbase wallets and their balances.

tools.name: coinbase_transactions
tools.description: One wallet's transactions over a period: buys, sells, sends, converts and reward income.

api_key_name.title: CDP API key name
api_key_name.description: The key's name from the Coinbase Developer Platform, organizations/<org>/apiKeys/<key> (an Ed25519 key's id also works). Create the key with only the View permission.

api_private_key.title: CDP API private key
api_private_key.description: The key's privateKey, as in the JSON file Coinbase gave you. Paste it as it is: the \n escapes or the line breaks both work.
